description: Canonical model state for the incident. Without a complete profile, the canonical model adapter (buildCanonicalModel) throws KUNDLI_CALCULATION_INCOMPLETE rather than producing an empty model.

data.expectedThrowReason: profile.coordinates.longitude is missing; profile.coordinates.provenance is missing; timezone not resolved
data.notes: The adapter (buildCanonicalModel in src/lib/kundli/canonicalModel.ts) requires a complete NormalizedBirthProfile. It never produces an empty canonical model. The legacy pipeline skipped this adapter entirely.
